evidence.reason: The parser removes `a/`/`b/` only from an unquoted `+++`/`---` value. Git C-quoted paths such as `+++ "b/src/a\tb.ts"` leave the quote and the `b/` prefix in `path`, so path-scoped denylist rules like `^src/` do not apply and added denylisted content can be missed. This is an implementation defect in the fail-closed denylist scan, not a new requirement.
